description: Use to give the user a link that opens the public data map (https://geo.nlp-tlp.org/map) on a view that shows an answer. The view can set layers to turn on (map layer ids such as drillholes, tenements, wamex, geology_au, geology, faults, offshore_titles / offshore_titles_pending (NOPTA), ilua (NNTT ILUAs), or library ids "lib:..."), a company or project's holdings drawn over the map, the drillhole filter, a place to centre on, and a pick (a point and radius, which opens the point's summary card; with view 3d, the 3D drillhole view, at most 10 km, optionally on one hole's card or its section). Returns the link; it builds the address only and fetches nothing. The map page itself can print the view or save it as PNG or PDF; no tool does that.

bbox.description: [w, s, e, n]: picks the rectangle (its summary card, or 3D with view 3d).

center.description: [lon, lat] or [lon, lat, zoom] (zoom 4 = the State, 8 = a region, 12 = a mine).

element.description: With view 3d: colour the holes by this element's grade (e.g. Au).

hole.description: With view 3d: open this hole's card (its name, e.g. MFED024).

section.description: With view 3d and hole: open the section through the hole.

name: make_map_link
title: Make a data map link
